rei_pr_235.body:
The scalar beta transfer lacked a concrete caller for moving reference density and proper time. This adds a six-state RHS, full analytic Jacobian/JVP, bound/continuum daughter accounting and a reference-covariant exact oracle. The moving finite-volume exchange uses one number/energy current and includes mesh work. Its thermal cutoff solve includes the affine moment term I_h=I0+L*theta_dot, corrected during independent review before the frozen run.

One authorized delta-only standard-library execution passed 15/15 groups: normalized beta 8 and moving exchange 7. Nine input snapshots match. Fresh independent decision: PASS_SCOPED_NORMALIZED_BETA_AND_MOVING_EXCHANGE_COMPONENTS. Prior 25 checks, source atom census and trajectories were reused without replay.

Parallel results include a positive frozen-Bianchi-I stress response with the -2p*sigma coupling, qualified DDEP tritium properties and moment-support obligations, and an HD source-precision diagnosis preserving the original 35 Hz gate. The tagged native BED energy representation preserves physical kinetic-energy semantics.

Canonical completion remains 29/88 with 59 incomplete. This adds one canonical component return; DAG.json, original contracts and owner reservations are unchanged. Native 33/30 client, original H5 history, full stopping and L4 remain open. This PR is stacked on the unmerged research/rei-parallel-blockers-20261026 branch (PR234), not a central-branch merge.

Execution: child 0.034406 CPU s, wrapper 0.028315604 s, conservative tail 0.01 s; total new debit 0.072721604 s below the frozen 0.1 s reservation. Known planning subtotal 9.874926553/10 plus explicitly UNKNOWN metadata costs; no exact all-process cap certification, reset or budget transfer.

Portable archive: 165,160 bytes, SHA256 3b45172b3fe688d48f014b93a79853170b151f2b0762266d4e1461aa98a2d6a9. Both Drive and Dropbox completion ACKs and separate size readbacks are available. Source publication covers 58 new-unit files plus one additive canonical return; final delivery identifiers and copyable handoff follow in a two-file metadata commit.

rei_pr_236.body:
The native PW19 photo source previously exposed abundance and energy moments without a distinct count for newborn nonthermal electrons. This change adds a 25-coordinate source/JVP: the 21 native REC abundances, nonthermal electron number, primary-electron energy, an external photon-energy ledger, and log gas temperature. At the saved z=2.479 snapshot, the thermal count is chi_th=(1+q)·Y−zeta. Photoionization changes q·Y and zeta equally, so this isolated pre-assimilation operator has zero thermal-count and log-temperature source. Binding, primary-electron and external-photon energy balance independently. Isotropic pressure-source bounds are supplied; they are not a stress closure.

The PR retains the earlier Lumina contracts, 13/13 adapter checks, 72/72 PW19 source checks and native REC callback evidence. The earlier native-callback admission advanced the original working DAG from 30/88 to 32/88. This new coupled-source loop adds a reviewed constructive PARTIAL to REC-COUPLED with zero additional node completions: 32/88 remains unchanged. The original 88 nodes, dependencies, nested gates and owner reservations are preserved; central authority remains unmerged at 27/88.

Validation: 28 passing checks from the first coupled-source attempt were reused, and 68 new checks passed in the targeted continuation. Maximum analytic residual is 3.0092e-16 against 2e-14; maximum finite-difference residual is 7.0001e-9 against 2e-8. Independent equation/code/raw-output/figure review is PASS_SCOPED. The first attempt's exact-floating-zero assertion failure and the second attempt's pre-start runner-monitor failure are preserved with raw receipts. The latter performed zero scientific checks; its underlying monitor discrepancy remains unknown. Scientific tolerances and physical source were unchanged. No IVP or earlier successful suite was replayed.

The source operates before thermal assimilation. Qualified stopping/assimilation, RR/DR and Compton coupling to the thermal electron bath, a source-matched physical history, signed matter/radiation stress and physical uncertainty allocation remain open. H6, HD same-fit precision input, physical beta daughters/stopping and V6 client obligations are not closed. This is not L4 closure or the final all-selected physical pilot.

Budget policy remains temporary automatic increases strictly below 50% of the original baseline, separate approval at 50% or above, then cap restoration without clearing debit. Planning cap 10→14 has expired; cap 10 is restored with known cumulative planning debit 12.196274495 CPU seconds (measured costs plus explicit conservative reserves). Main usage remains 595.225063/600 with NO_MORE_IVPs. Presentation cap 30→36 has expired; cap 30 is restored with cumulative 30.360058297 CPU seconds and 24.971073188 wall seconds including packaging. Unmeasured tails and remote/metadata costs remain unknown, not zero.

Scientific source commit: eda4c1c0424fc2da17280c52ac8143507b5c39bc. All 65 newly published paths matched local Git blob SHA-1, size, mode and type. The immutable portable archive contains 307 entries, is 3,477,069 bytes, and has SHA256 1b80efed0892f3368dc307e3cd6757b93dc444a4d7d2d186b352b926e230648a. Local ZIP/CRC checks passed; Drive and Dropbox acknowledged storage and separately reported matching sizes. Remote archive SHA256 was not independently re-downloaded. Reports, final figure, independent review, copyable handoff and final delivery metadata are under research/rei_expanded_event_consumer/coupled_source_20261027/. This remains a draft stacked on PR235.
